claims.disproof_condition: 條件：全新、聯亞或其他商用磊晶廠在一手文件寫出具名大廠以它的磷化銦光偵測器磊晶量產 100G 以上收發器，或英特磊的磷化銦磊晶片營收占比連兩季下滑。核查頻率：每季（英特磊、全新、聯亞財報與法說）。觸發後 48 小時：本 claim 加註，光二極體層與 InP 磊晶片層的讀圖重讀供給側。
claims.statement: IntelliEPI says it is the top InP PIN epiwafer supplier, accounting for almost 100% of 100G–200G InP PIN commercial (merchant) orders worldwide, that MBE-grown InP PIN performs better, and that it supplies three of the world's top four optoelectronic companies. Supplier self-report sourced to 'IET internal data' (L8: weak); VPEC's own report claims 800G receiver shipments doubling on MOCVD PD epi — the two self-reports do not reconcile.
